description: Implementation of PermissionDao interface for managing permissions, including methods for listing permissions, retrieving by ID, filtering by groups, and querying by criteria within a sales management system.

classes.name: PermissionDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation for permission entity, providing database operations related to permissions.

methods.name: listPermission
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all permissions, ordered by ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a permission by its unique ID.

methods.name: getPermissionsListByGroups
methods.description: Retrieves permissions associated with specified group IDs.

methods.name: listByCriteria
methods.description: Lists permissions based on given criteria, supporting filtering and pagination.
